nodes.question: How can the imposition of environmental taxes impact underdeveloped or developing countries differently?
nodes.answer: Environmental taxes in underdeveloped or developing countries may limit development activities such as R&D expenditure or force other savings, potentially negatively impacting the state of the environment in those regions.
